svg.text: KimiK3Layer: baseline trace and the TE features that cover it
Boxes are the operations of a plain PyTorch implementation of the layer; colored frames show what one TE module or kernel takes over. GEMMs run under te.autocast with any low-precision recipe.
causal short conv (k=4) + SiLU on q
one depthwise conv1d over [q | k | v]
f_a GEMM h -> 128, f_b GEMM 128 -> H
feature map, gates and chunked delta
g GEMM h -> H x 128 (output gate)
Q K^T, causal softmax, P V
gate GEMM h -> H x 128, x sigmoid
gate GEMM on full hidden h -> E
sort / gather latent rows by expert
several baseline ops, still PyTorch (one composite op)
several baseline ops fused into one TE kernel
